geography.text: Specific to the technology encountered in Switzerland in 2000. Well applicable to modern incineration practices in Europe or North America or Japan.

technology.text: Swiss HWI plant in 2000 with wet flue gas scrubber and low-dust SCR DeNOx facility. Gross thermal efficiency 74.4% and gross electric efficiency 10%.

timePeriod.text: Transfer coefficients for modern Swiss MSWI. Emission speciation based on early 90ies data.

representativeness.productionVolume: 2 Swiss HWI plants with a total capacity of 53'000 t/a.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: The 2 Swiss HWI plants, used as the inventory reference technology mix, have a total annual capacity of 53'000 tons of hazardous waste. This corresponds to 39% of the Swiss total installed capacity in 2000. Swiss average plants size is 20'000 t/a.
